sources.note: Nothing: 40-item Swadesh subset in ASJPcode orthography, which by design drops stress and tone marks, so even if the printed Anceaux list carries the volume's pre-vowel apostrophe stress marks they are not reproduced here. Value: open confirmation that Smits & Voorhoeve 1992 contains a Kaptiau list, and the only openly readable Kaptiau lexical data besides the Wikipedia table.
